reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Use the recovery token from the panel host to choose a new admin password.
reset.tokenHelp: Stored at data/reset-token.txt on the panel host.
reset.tokenHelpAlt: One of the recovery codes you saved from Settings → Security. Each code works once.
reset.tokenTooShort: Reset token must be at least 8 characters

recovery.helpLocal: This browser is running on the panel host. Create a recovery file, then use its token to reset the admin password.
recovery.helpRemote: Create data/reset-token.txt on the panel host with any token at least 8 characters long.
recovery.helpRemoteAlt: You can also start the panel with --reset-password from the server terminal.
recovery.noTokenError: No recovery token found yet. Create data/reset-token.txt on the panel host, then try again.
recovery.checkErrorMessage: Could not check recovery status. Try again in a moment.
